# Embrose AI

> Embrose AI is a hands-on AI consulting and automation practice based in Franklin, Indiana. Founder Collin Hill sets up AI bots (called "the Crew") and automations that take repetitive computer work off small teams, with a person approving anything sensitive. Clients are real estate teams, field, construction and home-services companies, and local businesses with 5–50 people in Franklin, Greenwood, Indianapolis and Johnson County, Indiana. He works in person within about an hour of Franklin and remotely anywhere.

Key facts:

- Business name: Embrose AI
- Base: Franklin, Indiana (service-area business, no public storefront)
- In person: Franklin, Greenwood, Indianapolis (especially the south side), all of Johnson County, and within about an hour of Franklin. Remote anywhere.
- Phone (call or text): (317) 777-1512
- Email: hello@embroseai.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Eastern
- Founder: Collin Hill, a Project Manager at TESCO with 2–3 years building AI pipelines
- First step: a free 30-minute intro call. Book at https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ0yawSmJtpIgeIMA0zk1iymCS4O4r5nwUGeA4RFV1U0QBN63m-uNV39AHM0bZLHATqr3UThmH34
- Published prices (USD):
  - AI Audit $1,500 fixed
  - Setup Sprint from $3,500
  - Process Implementation from $7,500
  - Monthly Retainer $1,500/month (up to 10 hours)
  - Embrose Crew 30-Day Pilot $1,500
  - Crew Starter $3,500 setup + $750/month
  - Crew Full Team from $7,500 setup + $1,500/month
  - Private/local AI setup is quoted after the AI Audit, with hardware billed separately.
- What it is not: Embrose AI does not offer accounting, bookkeeping, tax or CPA services. Its bots handle back-office tasks such as invoice prep, payment matching and follow-ups, alongside a client's existing staff.

## Services

- [Home: AI consulting in Franklin, Greenwood and Indianapolis](https://embroseai.com/): Overview of services, a sample-data demo of a Crew bot, pricing, the founder and FAQs
- [AI Audit](https://embroseai.com/ai-audit/): A $1,500 fixed-price workflow review with a written AI roadmap
- [The Embrose Crew: AI bots for back-office work](https://embroseai.com/ai-crew/): Bots for payment matching, invoice prep, follow-ups and inbox triage, starting with a $1,500 30-day pilot
- [Private local AI setup and AI server builds](https://embroseai.com/private-local-ai/): AI models that run on hardware the client owns, so data stays in-house
- [Pricing](https://embroseai.com/pricing/): Every published price in one place

## Industries

- [AI for real estate teams](https://embroseai.com/industries/real-estate-teams/): Portal lead replies, CRM cleanup, listing drafts and transaction deadline reminders
- [AI for field, construction and home-services companies](https://embroseai.com/industries/field-and-home-services/): Job intake, daily field reports, scheduling, quote drafts and invoice follow-ups
